_comment: Observation glow feel (see include/Glimmer.h). The warm glow marks an OBSERVABLE spot the player can examine: unobserved -> glows warm + breathes when in reach (a 'come look' prompt); observed -> dims to a muted persistent glow, brighter while in reach. Items are NOT glowed (they show their floor icon). All values tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source). Mirrors config/head_marker.json.
